dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures featuring sharp, high-contrast light perimeters surrounding low-intensity dark centers. The gradient transitions abruptly at the perimeter edges, which exhibit jagged, non-uniform geometry concentrated in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid high-intensity light pixel clusters is observed on the posterior flank, lacking internal gradients. A secondary sparse distribution of solid low-intensity dark blobs is visible near the anterior-dorsal transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an elongated obtuse triangle. A series of four high-intensity blobs near the anterior region forms a roughly linear-arc spatial relationship.
